in_hebrew.name: Baun
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו God's little one
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Baun הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'baon', meaning 'little one' or 'son'. In Christian tradition, the name Baun is given to babies as a reminder of their divine origin and their role as God's children.

in_greek.name: Baun
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει God's little one
in_greek.long_meaning: Baun είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek word 'baon', meaning 'little one' or 'son'. In Christian tradition, the name Baun is given to babies as a reminder of their divine origin and their role as God's children.

in_latin.name: Baun
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God's little one
in_latin.long_meaning: Baun est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek word 'baon', meaning 'little one' or 'son'. In Christian tradition, the name Baun is given to babies as a reminder of their divine origin and their role as God's children.
